jmp.text: Oketra's shot pierces Gideon's pegasus over Ravnica, and he falls holding the Blackblade.

mh2.text: Dakkon forges the Blackblade for Geyadrone Dihada, and unwittingly becomes part of her schemes.

j25.text: Gideon flies with the Blackblade, his dark sword, ready to strike a god as Ravnica watches.
